name: PLNK-series power droid
description: The PLNK-series power droid, nicknamed the plunk droid for its distinctive sound, was a heavy-duty power droid that held tibanna gas. It was manufactured by Industrial Automaton during the Clone Wars, where they saw widespread use in the Republic Navy.
